citation_details.title: DataSet1
citation_details.author: Ahmad Mheich, Olivier Dufor, Sahar Yassine, Aya Kabbara, Fabrice Wendling, Mahmoud Hassan
citation_details.abstract: This dataset is a mirror of OpenNeuro ds002791, containing EEG recordings and associated metadata. The dataset includes raw EEG data in standard formats (.eeg, .vhdr, .vmrk) along with BIDS-compliant documentation and participant information in TSV format.
